name: Backlinks
description: Extracts links from node fields and records which nodes link to each node (backlinks).
project_description:
Develop Backlinks using DDEV ⚙ 
 If you haven't already, install DDEV .

 
git clone git@git.drupal.org:project/backlinks.git
cd backlinks
ddev config --project-type=drupal --docroot=web --php-version=8.4 --corepack-enable --project-name=backlinks
ddev add-on get ddev/ddev-drupal-contrib
ddev add-on get s-ayers/ddev-drupal-contrib-mkdocs
ddev start
ddev poser
ddev symlink-project
ddev drush site:install -y
ddev drush pm:install backlinks -y
ddev drush config:export -y
ddev drush user:login
 Consider sponsoring DDEV development.
